readme.markdown:
# NegativeEV MCP server

Grade a sports bet against thousands of play-by-play game simulations, from
inside any MCP client.

```
claude mcp add --transport http negativeev https://negativeev.com/mcp
```

No API key, no signup, no OAuth dance. The server is public and free, and the
command above is the whole install.

- **Endpoint:** `https://negativeev.com/mcp`
- **Transport:** Streamable HTTP (stateless)
- **Auth:** optional bearer token
- **Registry:** `com.negativeev/bet-checker`
- **Server card:** https://negativeev.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

This repository holds the public documentation and the Claude Code plugin for
that server. The server itself runs at negativeev.com and its source is not
published here.

## What it does

NegativeEV takes a bet, simulates the underlying game or event thousands of
times play-by-play with a machine-learning simulation engine, and compares the
simulated win rate to the probability implied by the sportsbook's price. What
comes back is the simulated probability, the implied probability, and the edge
between them.

It is a checker, not a picks service. It never sells picks, never places bets,
and never handles money. Users bring a bet they were already thinking about and
find out what the price is actually worth. Most of the time the answer is that
the price is worse than it looks, which is where the name comes from.

Sports covered today: MLB, WNBA, PGA, and ATP, for events on the current slate
that have not started yet. Markets include moneylines, run lines and spreads,
totals, player props, and parlays built from them.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `check_bet` | Grades a bet written as plain text. Returns each leg's simulated probability, the implied probability from the price, and the edge. | Spends one check, and only when the bet fully grades |
| `get_slate` | Reports whether there is a checkable slate right now, per sport. | Free |
| `get_usage` | Reports checks remaining and when the next one frees up. | Free |

Every `check_bet` result leads with a `status` field, so a caller never has to
infer what happened from the numbers:

- `graded` — every leg scored. The only status that spends a check.
- `partial` — some legs scored.
- `ungraded` — the bet was understood, but no leg is covered by the sims.
- `no_bet_found` — no bet was recognized in the text.
- `no_slate`, `unsupported_market`, `unsupported_sport` — self-explanatory.

An `ungraded` bet was understood correctly. Rewording it and sending it again
returns the same answer. Call `get_slate` instead to see what is checkable.

## Install

### Claude Code

```
claude mcp add --transport http negativeev https://negativeev.com/mcp
```

### Claude Desktop

Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, then paste
`https://negativeev.com/mcp`.

### Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP clients

The server is plain streamable HTTP with no auth requirement, so any client that
accepts a remote MCP URL works. Point it at `https://negativeev.com/mcp`.

An install page with per-client instructions is served at
https://negativeev.com/mcp in a browser.

## Claude Code plugin

The plugin in this repo bundles the server config plus a `check-a-bet` skill
that teaches Claude when to reach for it and how to read the result.

```
/plugin marketplace add negative-ev/negativeev-mcp
/plugin install negativeev@negativeev
```

## Usage

Ask in plain language. Some prompts that exercise each tool:

- "Is Shohei Ohtani over 1.5 total bases at -120 a good bet tonight?"
- "Here's my parlay: Ohtani over 0.5 home runs +280 and Dodgers moneyline -150. Worth it?"
- "Is there a checkable MLB slate tonight?"
- "How many bet checks do I have left today?"

## Authentication and limits

Anonymous callers share a per-device quota of 100 checks a day. Sending a
signed-in user's Supabase access token as `Authorization: Bearer` raises that to
1000 an hour.

There is no agent self-registration: no dynamic client registration, no
`client_credentials` grant, and no API keys. An agent acts on behalf of a
signed-in user. An invalid or expired token is rejected with a 401 rather than
silently downgraded to anonymous, so re-authenticate instead of retrying.

Full details: https://negativeev.com/auth.md

## About

NegativeEV is built in Portland by Jesse. The simulator is the product — the
betting side is just the scoreboard that measures whether the simulations match
reality better than the market does.

- Site: https://negativeev.com
- How it works: https://negativeev.com/about/how-it-works
- For AI agents: https://negativeev.com/about/for-agents
- X: https://x.com/negative__EV

Verdicts are estimates from simulations, not guarantees. Analysis for
information, not betting advice. 21+ where required.

toolsPreview.name: check_bet
toolsPreview.description: Grade a sports bet against NegativeEV's game simulations. Input the bet as plain text (teams/players, market, line, odds); a multi-leg parlay in one string is graded leg by leg and priced as a whole. Use it when the caller has a SPECIFIC bet to evaluate — it prices a bet you name, it does not search for good bets, so there is nothing to send for 'what should I bet tonight'. Call `get_slate` first if it isn't known that today's games are simulated. Every result leads with `status`: `graded` (every leg scored — this is the only status that spends a check), `partial` (some legs scored), `ungraded` (the bet was understood but no leg is covered by the sims), `no_bet_found` (no bet recognized in the text), or `no_slate`, `unsupported_market`, `unsupported_sport`. When a leg doesn't score, `ungraded_legs[].reason` says why and `retry.rephrasing_helps` says whether re-wording could change the answer — it is false whenever the bet parsed, so do NOT resend the same bet in different words to work around an `ungraded` result. Covers MLB, WNBA, PGA, and ATP; any other sport returns unsupported_sport. Games that already started still grade, against the simulations from before first pitch (a pre-game projection, flagged as such).

toolsPreview.name: get_slate
toolsPreview.description: Whether there is a checkable slate right now (at least one simulated, not-yet-started game) in each live sport: MLB, WNBA, PGA, and ATP. Pass `sport` to ask about one; omit it for all of them. This is the free pre-check for `check_bet`: call it before grading when it isn't known that today's games are simulated, and call it after an `ungraded` result instead of re-wording the bet, because `ungraded` means the game isn't on the simulated slate rather than that the wording was wrong. Free — spends no check.

toolsPreview.name: get_usage
toolsPreview.description: How many bet checks the caller has left and when the next one frees up — the daily allowance for anonymous callers, the hourly pace window for accounts. Call it before grading several bets in one turn, to know how many will fit, and after a check is refused for quota, to know when to retry. It reports the budget only; `check_bet` is what spends it. Free — spends no check.
